title: Psalm 8
opening_line: How excellent in all the earth,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: How excellent in all the earth,
text.normalized: How excellent in all the earth,
text.reading: How excellent in all the earth,

text.diplomatic: LORD, our Lord, is thy name!
text.normalized: LORD, our Lord, is thy name!
text.reading: LORD, our Lord, is thy name!

text.diplomatic: Who hast thy glory far advanced
text.normalized: Who hast thy glory far advanced
text.reading: Who hast thy glory far advanced

text.diplomatic: above the starry frame.
text.normalized: Above the starry frame.
text.reading: above the starry frame.

text.diplomatic: From infants’ and from sucklings’ mouth
text.normalized: From infants’ and from sucklings’ mouth
text.reading: From infants’ and from sucklings’ mouth

text.diplomatic: thou didest strength ordain,
text.normalized: Thou didest strength ordain,
text.reading: thou didest strength ordain,

text.diplomatic: For thy foes’ cause, that so thou might’st
text.normalized: For thy foes’ cause, that so thou might’st
text.reading: For thy foes’ cause, that so thou might’st

text.diplomatic: th’ avenging foe restrain.
text.normalized: Th’ avenging foe restrain.
text.reading: th’ avenging foe restrain.

text.diplomatic: When I look up unto the heav’ns,
text.normalized: When I look up unto the heav’ns,
text.reading: When I look up unto the heav’ns,

text.diplomatic: which thine own fingers framed,
text.normalized: Which thine own fingers framed,
text.reading: which thine own fingers framed,

text.diplomatic: Unto the moon, and to the stars,
text.normalized: Unto the moon, and to the stars,
text.reading: Unto the moon, and to the stars,

text.diplomatic: which were by thee ordained;
text.normalized: Which were by thee ordained;
text.reading: which were by thee ordained;

text.diplomatic: Then say I, What is man, that he
text.normalized: Then say I, What is man, that he
text.reading: Then say I, What is man, that he

text.diplomatic: remembered is by thee?
text.normalized: Remembered is by thee?
text.reading: remembered is by thee?

text.diplomatic: Or what the son of man, that thou
text.normalized: Or what the son of man, that thou
text.reading: Or what the son of man, that thou

text.diplomatic: so kind to him should’st be?
text.normalized: So kind to him should’st be?
text.reading: so kind to him should’st be?

text.diplomatic: For thou a little lower hast
text.normalized: For thou a little lower hast
text.reading: For thou a little lower hast

text.diplomatic: him than the angels made;
text.normalized: Him than the angels made;
text.reading: him than the angels made;

text.diplomatic: With glory and with dignity
text.normalized: With glory and with dignity
text.reading: With glory and with dignity

text.diplomatic: thou crownèd hast his head.
text.normalized: Thou crownèd hast his head.
text.reading: thou crownèd hast his head.

text.diplomatic: Of thy hands’ works thou mad’st him lord,
text.normalized: Of thy hands’ works thou mad’st him lord,
text.reading: Of thy hands’ works thou mad’st him lord,

text.diplomatic: all under ’s feet didst lay;
text.normalized: All under ’s feet didst lay;
text.reading: all under ’s feet didst lay;

text.diplomatic: All sheep and oxen, yea, and beasts
text.normalized: All sheep and oxen, yea, and beasts
text.reading: All sheep and oxen, yea, and beasts

text.diplomatic: that in the field do stray;
text.normalized: That in the field do stray;
text.reading: that in the field do stray;

text.diplomatic: Fowls of the air, fish of the sea,
text.normalized: Fowls of the air, fish of the sea,
text.reading: Fowls of the air, fish of the sea,

text.diplomatic: all that pass through the same.
text.normalized: All that pass through the same.
text.reading: all that pass through the same.

text.diplomatic: How excellent in all the earth,
text.normalized: How excellent in all the earth,
text.reading: How excellent in all the earth,
